project_name: Character model sheet, 4 turnaround views showing front, back, three-quarters, and side profile in one image of Ren Mishima, 25-year-old Japanese street racer and GT3 driver known as The Ghost of C1. Messy layered jet-black anime hair with burning amber highlighted tips, stylish amber-tinted frameless driving glasses, intense focused eyes, cool smirk. Wearing a dark gunmetal grey techwear racing suit with glowing sunset-amber hazard stripes, Japanese kanji street racing decals on sleeves, high-grip black racing sneakers. A matte gunmetal GT3 helmet with sunset-amber mirror visor resting on his hip. Crisp cel-shaded anime style, thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, sharp geometric shadows, neutral grey studio background
